replies.body:
voting is good (and rewards players for promoting the server)

web ads (they cost money but if you didnt make them annoying as hell they could probably get some people)
tell ur friends to come on

talk about the games discreetly on other servers you play on-- the reason i came on when it was mczone was because the main server i played on had a few people that constantly talked about the walls on mczone so i joined and i've been here since.
